🏛 Acting Chairman — Bangladesh Nationalist Party
Tarique Rahman
A lifelong democratic activist and the son of BNP founder Ziaur Rahman, Tarique Rahman has been the driving force behind BNP's modernisation and commitment to democratic values. As Acting Chairman, he leads the party's vision for a free, prosperous and just Bangladesh.
🗳 Democratic Reformer 📜 Architect of 31-Point Charter 🌍 International Advocate 🇧🇩 Son of the Founder

Our History

Decades of Democratic Struggle

From the founding vision of Ziaur Rahman to today's reform movement — a journey of service to the nation.

1978
Foundation of BNP
President Ziaur Rahman founds the Bangladesh Nationalist Party on 1 September 1978, establishing a democratic, nationalist platform for Bangladesh.
🏛
🗳
1979
First Electoral Victory
BNP wins a landslide majority in the 2nd National Parliament Election, with Ziaur Rahman's government launching major development initiatives.
1991
Begum Khaleda Zia — First Female PM
BNP wins democratic elections and Begum Khaleda Zia becomes Bangladesh's first female Prime Minister, ushering in a new era of democratic governance.
⭐
🏆
2001
Landslide Victory — Third Term
BNP wins two-thirds parliamentary majority. Major infrastructure, education and economic development projects transform Bangladesh.
2023
31-Point Reform Charter
BNP unveils the historic 31-Point National Reform Charter, the most comprehensive political reform agenda in Bangladesh's post-independence history.
📜
🔮
2026
Ready for Election 2026
BNP prepares for the 13th National Parliament Election with a unified mandate, grassroots mobilisation across all 300 constituencies.
